description: The parent backup-rest-api.md's Configuration category table lists THREE HTTP methods for `/api/v1/config` - GET, POST, and PUT. backup-manage-config.md, whose entire job is to document that endpoint, only ever mentions GET and POST: PUT never appears in an HTTP Methods and URIs section, a curl example, or a Required Permissions line anywhere on the page. Either the overview table is wrong (PUT does not exist), or backup-manage-config.md is missing a third of its own subject matter.
